img.description: High quality Base64 encoded image. Subject to image requirements https://developers.yoti.com/age-estimation/overview#image-requirements

img_validation_level.description: (optional) The level of validations to be applied against the image and bounding boxes to support different sizes of images.

secure.description: Required for SICAP Secure image capture) Secure information that certifies the image was not modified. The Yoti React Face Capture provides this information that shouldn't be edited.

age_estimation_model.description: (optional) Select a specific age estimation model to execute. [Please get in touch with us to discuss switching to a different model.]
